organizer: GDXR Club, Army Institute of Technology (AIT) Pune
summary: We collect team registration details solely for organizing brackets, verifying eligibility, coordinating check-ins, and distributing tournament updates for GENESIS 2026.
dataCollected: Selected Competitive Track (Gaming Championship or VR Track)
Squad Leader Full Name, Email Address, and Phone Number
Squad Members Full Name, Email Address, and optional Phone Number
usage: Tournament seedings, match scheduling, and bracket management
Sending official confirmation emails and Discord access tokens
Emergency contact during on-campus LAN and VR events
Verification of student/participant identity during badge pickup
retention: All registration records are retained for 90 days following the conclusion of GENESIS 2026, after which non-anonymized personal data is securely purged.
thirdPartySharing: We do not sell, rent, or share personal participant information with commercial third parties or external advertisers.
security: Data is stored on Postgres with Row Level Security (RLS) and encrypted transport (TLS 1.3). Access is restricted to authorized GDXR tournament admins.
